contracts.evidence: DensityInput checks complete index triples, paired position/UV lengths, every finite position and UV, host-index conversion and membership. Then scale checks both accumulated lengths, narrowed coefficient and every replacement coordinate product before mutation. Exclusive mutable receiver prevents column changes between admission and replacement. Comments limit this admission to positions/chart/topology used here, explicitly excluding normals, skin, components and morphs.
contracts.disposition: Accurate bounded operation contract; no global GeneratedArmor validity guarantee.

contracts.evidence: Input positions are documented model-space metres and UV chart dimensionless. Difference remains f32 before f64 widening, same edge/sum/root order as old free function. Scale retains f64 ratio -> f32 narrowing -> Metal::TILES_PER_METRE. Ratio is a policy-free unit carrier; owning checks prove current scale finite. No epsilon floor exists. With admitted paired finite columns, empty triangle set or zero accumulated UV edge length returns unchanged. Positive UV edge length and zero surface yields coefficient zero; finite UVs become zero.
contracts.disposition: Rustdoc matches actual arithmetic and retains successful degenerate behavior. No promise of uniform local surface density or physical-model correctness was inferred.

Old free function is removed.

contracts.evidence: ExhibitFit distinguishes initial Pending, Fitted(GeneratedArmor) and Failed(anyhow::Error).
